occurrence_sentence: "Alexandra Beckstein, Co-Founder and CEO of QAI Ventures, is making remarkable strides in creating a world-leading quantum ecosystem. Our fund and portfolio companies benefit immensely from being embedded within this ecosystem, allowing us to leverage access to a global quantum network and hardware resources," stated Lukas André, Managing Partner of Redstone Switzerland.
